}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "10013665", "V1.1", and a lead-free logo is silkscreened on the board. :The same board would appear to be used by the [[Tenda W309R]].
The BCM5357C0 is marked w/ the '''Broadcom''' logo, ''BCM5357C0KFBG'', :''HE1151 P30'', ''177054 01B W''.
The default SSID format is presumed to be ''Tenda_XXXXXX'' :(it's in the FCC manual).
The power adapter shown in the FCC external photos is a :'''Shenzhen Heweishun Network Technology''' TEA09-09100 :(100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.3A -> 9VDC, 1.0A).
